The '''Yavin Bypass''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] that bypassed the [[Loop Worlds|Loop World]] of [[Torque]] by going past [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], in his battered [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]], took the eastern terminus of the route to [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]] where he rejoined the Imperial fleet.
